title: Call
stuck: Still waiting for {name}. If nothing comes, say it again.
transcript.label: Conversation
transcript.empty: Call {name} to start talking. You can speak or type.
transcript.waiting: {name} speaks first once the call connects.
audio.blocked: Your browser is holding back {name}'s voice.
memory.offHint: Memory needs Qdrant. Set it up in Settings so {name} remembers your calls.
memory.downHint: Qdrant isn't answering, so {name} won't remember this call.
mic.denied.title: Your microphone is blocked
mic.denied.body: Allow microphone access for this page in your browser's site settings, then call again.
mic.busy.title: Your microphone is in use
mic.busy.body: Another app is using your microphone. Close it, then call again.
mic.missing.title: No microphone found
mic.missing.body: Connect a microphone, then call again.
mic.insecure.title: The microphone isn't available here
mic.insecure.body: Browsers allow the microphone only on secure pages. Open Eidolon at http://localhost or http://127.0.0.1.
mic.unknown.title: Your microphone didn't start
mic.unknown.body: Check your microphone, then call again.
ended.silence: The call ended after 5 minutes of silence.
ended.failed: The call failed on Eidolon's side.
ended.ice: Couldn't get the connection settings for the call.
botError.title: {name} ran into an error
botError.body: The voice (Fish Audio) or the model (OpenRouter) reported a problem. Check their keys and credit in Settings.
voice.missing.title: Pick a voice for {name}
voice.missing.body: A call needs a voice. Pick one of Fish Audio's public voices first.
voice.unknown: Fish Audio can't use {name}'s voice, so calls may have no sound.
voice.inheritedUnknown: Fish Audio can't use the voice {name} inherits from FISH_VOICE_ID, so calls may have no sound.
voice.inheritedHint: Pick her own voice: it overrides the environment's for her alone.
keys.missing.title: Add your API keys first
keys.missing.body: Calls need Soniox, OpenRouter and Fish Audio keys.
